name: ADEZ XMD
description: ADEZ XMD is a WhatsApp bot with a terminal-style menu, group tools and fun commands.

SESSION_ID.description: Session ID from the Session ID Generator (step 1)

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner WhatsApp number with country code, no + sign

MODE.description: Who can use the bot: public or private

MENU_IMAGE.description: Optional picture link for the menu (leave empty for none)

NODE_VERSION.description: Node version the bot runs on
